basics.name: Jose Tupayachi
basics.label: Data and AI Engineer
basics.summary: Data and AI Engineer specializing in scalable ETL/ELT, distributed computing, machine learning, and multimodal AI across Python, SQL, Scala, and Java. Builds distributed data platforms on public cloud, designs dimensional data models and lakehouse architectures for cloud data warehouses, and delivers real-time streaming and NoSQL applications on UNIX/Linux. Engineers end-to-end, agentic AI-driven data workflows from ingestion, transformation, and orchestration to predictive modeling and decision support, integrating large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Vision Transformers, and entity resolution. Published in Computers & Electrical Engineering and the Health Informatics Journal, and has filed intellectual property disclosures at Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

work.name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory / ORISE
work.summary: AI researcher developing multimodal foundation models and scientific AI systems for materials science, fusion energy, and geospatial intelligence under DOE-funded programs.
highlights: Built Vision Transformer (ViT) and foundation vision models within a multi-pathway hybrid architecture powering Automated Quality Assurance of Meteorological Station Data for Atmospheric Dispersion Modeling (CAPARS), classifying wind speed and direction across distributed station networks.

Developed agentic, traceable multimodal AI pipelines with LangChain and LangSmith, integrating large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to automate expert literature review and materials-discovery workflows.

Fine-tuned and deployed local open-weight models (Qwen, Llama) served via Ollama for autonomous literature mining and knowledge extraction, and accelerated delivery with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code).
Created explainable ML models for extreme weather and environmental systems using large-scale atmospheric and geospatial datasets, with automated data-quality and anomaly-detection checks.
Developed geospatial AI interfaces enabling natural-language querying, knowledge-graph reasoning, and interactive analytics over scientific spatial datasets.
Built LLM-powered decision-support systems and automated dashboards, filed as ORNL intellectual property disclosures.

work.name: University of Tennessee, Knoxville
work.summary: Researcher in AI-driven transportation systems, digital twins, and multimodal machine learning for mobility, healthcare, and infrastructure applications.
highlights: Lead development of AI-powered freight transportation digital twins under the $3M DOE ARPA-E RECOIL project, delivering real-time spatiotemporal prediction and system optimization.
Designed and implemented deep learning architectures (MLP, CNN, LSTM, transformer-based models) for EV charging-demand forecasting and spatiotemporal prediction.
Built agentic LLM workflows and RAG chatbots for domain-specific trade-off analysis, deployed to production for non-technical decision-makers.
Delivered multimodal ML systems for cross-platform mobile health apps (SmartShots, ACTAPP), published to the App Store and Google Play.
Worked in Agile sprints and mentored junior researchers in model development and reproducible computational workflows.

work.name: Indra
work.summary: Data engineer supporting enterprise-scale ETL pipelines, distributed data processing, and cloud migration for large-scale analytics systems.
highlights: Built and maintained scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, Scala, and Shell scripting on UNIX/Linux, processing high-volume enterprise data in Agile delivery cycles.

Developed distributed data processing systems using Scala/PySpark on Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive/HQL, and AWS (S3, EMR), migrating legacy Oracle warehouses to a partitioned cloud lakehouse and tuning Spark memory and resource allocation for faster job execution.
Designed dimensional data models for data warehousing and implemented entity-resolution and deduplication logic to unify records across source systems.
Implemented CI/CD deployment automation with Jenkins for automated builds, unit testing, and application deployment.
Strengthened data quality (ad-hoc quality engine), profiling, and anomaly detection through validation frameworks and monitoring/alerting, and tuned Spark memory and resource allocation.

projects.name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory - Scientific AI
projects.description: Research Fellow. Deployed advanced computer vision, multimodal AI, and scientific computing systems for materials science. Funding: DOE Office of Science (SC), Fusion Energy Sciences (FES), DOE Office of Environmental Management (EM), Nuclear Safety Research and Development (NSRD).
highlights: Developed AI-agent workflows for materials discovery, scientific knowledge extraction, and literature exploration.
Built computer vision, Vision Transformer (ViT), and foundation vision models for scanning electron microscopy (SEM) image characterization.
Applied multimodal AI systems to automate microstructure analysis, defect identification, phase characterization, and feature extraction from scientific imagery.
Designed explainable machine learning models for extreme weather event prediction using atmospheric, environmental, and sensor datasets.
Created automated dashboard generation and scientific decision-support systems using LLMs and RAG.

projects.name: RECOIL - Cognitive Freight Transportation Digital Twin
projects.description: Lead AI/Data Engineer. End-to-end cognitive digital twin for large-scale intermodal freight transportation. Funding: U.S. Department of Energy ARPA-E, Project #DE-AR0001780.
highlights: Designed ontology-guided optimization models integrating GIS-based transport modes (road, rail, waterways) for cost and emissions minimization.
Leveraged Convolutional and Graph Neural Networks to analyze weather, traffic, and demand impacts on EV charging behavior.
Applied large language models to power a domain-specific chatbot for trade-off analysis between cost, time, and CO2 emissions.
Developed the unified UI using Flutter, deployed to production.

projects.name: SmartShots - Childhood Vaccination App

highlights: Developed a scalable Laravel backend and cross-platform Dart/Flutter frontend, published to the App Store and Google Play.
Integrated community health information for real-time access to nearby vaccination providers.
Winner, IISE DAIS Student Mobile App Competition 2024.

projects.name: Active Caregiver's Toolkit (ACTAPP)

Integrated a ChatBot for FAQ answering and page/interaction tracking metrics for data analysis.
